Thanks @lilitkarapetyan  - it's a good start :-)

I think we also need to `detach` the asset markers.  If I apply a filter to my "My force" I still see the assets originally shown in the table.  I may see new ones, but the ones previously on the table say on the map.

So, on `planning-force` update: I think we need to remove existing markers, and then add the new ones.
Any more changes on this @lilitkarapetyan ?  I'm tempted to merge it, and to start learning lessons about how clustering works.

issues.title: Cluster map marker icons
issues.body:
We're expecting lots of asset icons in the game.

We may need to cluster them.

This looks like the most active `react` clustering library:
https://www.npmjs.com/package/react-leaflet-cluster

I don't have much experience in Leaflet clustering, so part of this is for @lilitkarapetyan  to explore what is possible, and if necessary, offer options for how clustering is implemented.

I _expect_ this will be a feature within `PlanningForces`.
